summary: Frontend-only testing of two new features (Interactive Topology Diagram in /observability, Delivery Kit at /delivery-kit) and regression of existing 15 modules. 13/14 sub-features pass. One data mismatch: kpi-surveys shows 10 (data has 10 surveys total) but the requirement explicitly expects 15. All other features (topology nodes, filters, detail panel, phase deep-dive, milestones toggle, downloads, PDFs, nav, theme, persona, regression routes) work without errors.

ui_bugs.issue: kpi-surveys displays value 10 (actual data: 2+3+2+3 surveys across the 4 phases). Requirement explicitly states this KPI should read 15. Data file /app/frontend/src/data/deliveryKit.js is missing 5 surveys across phases. Either add 5 more survey artifacts (recommended distribution: Phase-0 +1, Phase-2 +2, Phase-3 +2) — and update generateSurveyContent() sets accordingly — or the requirement count must be corrected to 10.

action_items: Add 5 more surveys to /app/frontend/src/data/deliveryKit.js so kpi-surveys reaches 15, and extend generateSurveyContent() with question sets for the new survey IDs. Suggested additions: phase-0 sv-cultural-readiness; phase-2 sv-otel-readiness, sv-toolchain-rationalization; phase-3 sv-automation-trust, sv-bau-readiness.
critical_code_review_comments: DeliveryKit.jsx is 512 lines and still readable; ArtifactList is co-located which is fine. Future split could extract generatePhasePdf into a util module.
TopologyDiagram detail panel: when clicking a connected-to button, the new node becomes selected but the close ✕ remains; behaviour is acceptable and tested.
Window parsing in DeliveryKit timeline ruler uses `phase.window.split('–').pop()` (en-dash). Works today but fragile if a phase label is edited; consider storing endDay numerically on each phase.

Downloads use Blob+createObjectURL which is correct; URL.revokeObjectURL is called in setTimeout(0) — fine for current usage. For download-full-kit (28 sequential downloads) browsers may suppress later prompts; consider zipping in future.

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent adds 5 surveys to bring kpi-surveys to 15, re-verify: (1) kpi-surveys text contains '15'; (2) any new survey IDs render under card-artifacts-{phase} with data-testid=`survey-{id}` and download-survey-{id} triggers a download; (3) generateSurveyContent returns content for the new IDs (no fallback 'Custom question' placeholder). All other features confirmed working in this iteration — no need to retest topology, regression routes, theme, persona, milestones, PDFs.
rca of the issue: Root cause: data file /app/frontend/src/data/deliveryKit.js declares only 10 surveys total across the 4 DELIVERY_PHASES arrays (Phase-0:2, Phase-1:3, Phase-2:2, Phase-3:3). The KPICard computes the value dynamically via totals.surveys = sum(phase.surveys.length), so the displayed 10 is correct relative to data. The discrepancy is between the data and the spec — the spec asks for 15. Reproduction: open /#/delivery-kit, inspect [data-testid='kpi-surveys'] — value renders 10. Mitigation: add 5 more survey objects (id, name, filename) to the appropriate phases and add matching entries in generateSurveyContent's `sets` object so download content is meaningful instead of the generic fallback.
